body:
Real Kismet architecture researched: monitor-mode capture, Radiotap+802.11 dissection, device tracking, channel hopping. Real foundation checked: pentest/pcap.prn already real for plain capture, NATIVE_PCAP_NORTHSTAR.md's own byte-level primitive findings extend directly to 802.11. Recommends shelling out to iw for monitor-mode control. 4-phase plan; Phase 1 (frame parser) buildable/testable now with no hardware; Phase 2+ honestly untestable in this sandbox (no WiFi hardware). No code written -- planning only.
